findings.body: `sourceRowValue` checks the formula object itself for `""` before resolving its cached result. A dimension cell containing `{ formula/sharedFormula, result: "" }` therefore bypasses the null branch and returns an empty string; whitespace-only cells behave similarly after trimming. This converts missing dimensions into `""` rather than `null`, potentially creating false dimension identifiers downstream. The tests cover direct null cells and non-empty cached formulas but not cached blank dimensions.
findings.title: Not done: Cached blank formulas must preserve null dimensions

findings.body: The permitted path list does not include `.factory/stories/FINANCIAL-AGENT-DEMO/tasks/ACTUAL-PARSER.json`, but the branch still adds this workflow-state file. It is unnecessary for the parser implementation or tests and contains stale findings that the current code has already addressed, so it must be removed from this scoped change.
